author: pm
body:
Replace the software cursor (`m_sprite[MouseCursor]`, sprite 8 of `interface/game_dialogs`, drawn by `CGame::draw_cursor`) with the user's high-resolution sheet `working/sprite_work/cursors.png`: sword, blue and red magic circles, five gauntlet hands (plain and blue/red outlined), hourglass, target corner brackets, black square. Drawn in screen space (phase 1 already moved the cursor there) at window resolution, same logical size and hotspot as today. Closes when its sub-tasks are done.

**Done when:** every sub-task is done and the cursors are checked in game at 800x600 and 1440x1080.

Source: user request 2026-11-23, art working\sprite_work\cursors.png (1406x124 RGBA, measured).
